channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 23
item.description:
27 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • New squirrel and rabbit sounds added, giving players audible cues to locate these critters.
  • The Nuclear Missile Site loot room has been restored after file conflicts, making its loot available again.
  • Shield footstep sounds now correctly align with the view when looking down, fixing mismatched audio cues.
  • Grenade drop timing synced with throw release so grenades spawn at the expected moment, and the drop animation now plays correctly on the player model.

Animals & Wildlife

Monuments & Loot

  • The Nuclear Missile Site loot room has been restored after file conflicts, making its loot available again.

Structures & Upkeep

  • Helipad repair now requires 30,000 wood, 10,000 metal fragments, and 100 rope.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Shield footstep sounds now correctly align with the view when looking down, fixing mismatched audio cues.
  • Grenade drop timing synced with throw release so grenades spawn at the expected moment, and the drop animation now plays correctly on the player model.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 22
item.description:
118 development commits

Livestock & Farming

  • Doubled dung production speed for cows and sheep; fixed horse dung bug and set horse dung per calorie to 0.2.
  • Harvest yields increased: cows now give 30 cloth, 100 leather, 100 bones, 20 beef, 40 fat; sheep now give 10 cloth, 20 leather, 50 bones, 12 mutton, 20 fat plus any wool they have.
  • Livestock sales charts reworked with a random reward pool (turrets, HQM, rifles, scrap, saddles, rope, blue cards, tarps, CCTV, targeting computers, frags); wool chart updated accordingly.
  • Animals automatically dismount when their vehicle rolls over or submerges; white sheep are now the beneficial gene variant; groundwatch collider layer issue fixed.

Map & Navigation

  • Fixed deep‑sea boat transfer bug that left players behind near walls; introduced jellyfish swarms as a new critter group.

Power, Tech & Construction

  • Adjusted power phase requirements, tweaked loot spawn types, corrected harbor_1 topology, and updated helipad repair requirements.
  • Biofuel generator added with description, crafting costs, tech‑tree entry, and corrected deployment orientation; related tech‑tree fixes applied.

New Structures & Environmental

  • Added new ferry terminal, radtown, and oil rig structures.
  • Waterwheel melee protection increased by 4–5×.
  • Oil rigs no longer emit radiation while the locked crate is untouched; crate hacked state persists after server restarts; chicken eggs now drop flush with terrain and avoid physics glitches.

Combat & Audio

  • Fixed fire arrows sticking to the third‑person bow for other players.
  • Prisoner hood now muffles voice while keeping chat clear.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Pool cue visual quality now stays consistent in first‑person when swapping between different cues.
  • Cows no longer incorrectly receive crocodile protection, fixing unintended protection behavior.

Building & Base

  • Base interiors now correctly collapse to a single outside, preventing interior rooms from being flagged as exterior.
  • Single‑door controllers retain proper orientation after reskin; doors no longer rotate 90°.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Loadout UI now correctly positions items in their icon slots.
  • Crystal AK store page displays correct takeover data, fixing purchase display issues.
  • Store refresh fully restarts the current tab, ensuring tile listings update properly.
  • Store overlay images support distinct configurations per URL, fixing incorrect mipmap usage on shared URLs.
  • Store item overlay page refcounting fixed, preventing crashes or visual glitches when opening and closing overlays.
  • Bundle purchases now correctly list all items in LastBoughtItems and show proper notifications.
  • HttpImage texture cache only clears when unused, preventing sprites from disappearing during interactions.
  • Vending machine UI font size standardized, fixing inconsistent text sizing.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Sep 21
item.description:
118 development commits

Animals & Farming

  • Sheep now drop the wool they were wearing at death.
  • Lambs no longer drop dung; sheep dung drop bug fixed.
  • Bad genes are now more common, making generic‑looking sheep and cows prevalent; good genes (e.g., black sheep) are rarer.
  • Collider sizes for livestock and critters adjusted, improving hit detection and interaction.
  • Sheep trophy head added to hunting trophies; male calf ragdoll display corrected for female bodies.

Food & Recovery

  • Regular and rich mutton pies halve livestock bonding time (rich reduces an extra 30 s) and prevent bulls from charging.
  • Regular and rich beef pies increase max food duration by 75 % (875 cal) and boost downed‑player recovery chance to 75 % (regular) or 100 % (rich) after hunger bar is full.

Vehicles & Transport

  • Ridable horse prefab added, allowing players to mount horses.
  • Boat power‑down fixed when lowering sails and jumping off quickly, preventing uncontrolled drifting.
  • Mounting UI improvements: prompt only appears when leading an animal, slots now indicate supported size, and cows require the large flatbed.

Base Building & Infrastructure

  • External gate upgrades now persist; deployables no longer clip through or disappear when doors close, and fuseboxes restored on all applicable monuments.
  • Deployable placement respects terrain deformation with configurable tolerance, foundations align to original terrain height, oil pumps now have a 15‑minute start delay (total 35 min cycle), and helipad repair stages affect functionality.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Store UI edge case fixed when player has no items.
  • Crafting menu overflow resolved by reducing category button width; mini crossbow fractional reload behavior corrected.
  • Computer station identifier input box text no longer disappears at various screen resolutions.
  • Sprint animation correctly stops when a networked attack is registered, fixing visual desync.
  • Loadout items now use proper container placement and older loadouts default to a safe position, fixing item placement bugs.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Hair and eyebrows customization now displays correctly, fixing overridden visuals.
  • Remote‑controlled turrets, drones and cameras ignore base occlusion, making them visible through walls (anti‑ESP).
  • Squirrel critters now move at adjusted speeds, changing how quickly they flee and can be harvested.
